page.layout: One text column, with an indented verse quotation in the middle; running head and page number at the top; a marginal note in the left margin beside the first verse line; catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: virginibus, earumque, cum adolescentibus, ut ita illarum corpora luctà, cursu, reliquisque ejus generis virilibus in-citamentis, non secus atque marium, ad labores perferen-dos aptiora redderentur. Utrumque institutum Græco-rum Poëta Propertius descri-psit hisce versibus:

p.i: Multa tua Sparte miramur iura palaestra, Sed mage virginei tot bona Gymnasii, Quod non infames exercet corpore ludos, Inter luctantes nuda puella viros. Cum pila veloces fallit per brachia jactus Increpat & versi clavis adunca trochi. Pulverulentaque ad extremas flat fœmina metas Et patitur duro vulnera pancra-tia.:

page.notes: The marginal note at the left is three short lines ("Propert." / "Eleg. 13." / "libr. 3."), set as one note. The verse quotation is set as one stanza in italics. The catchword "Nunc" is at the lower right. The page number and running head "P. VOET" are at the top. Page furniture and a small mark at the foot were left out. The final line ends "pancra-tia.:" with a colon as printed.
